reviews.title: I had a positive experience using Nebula
reviews.text: I had a really positive experience using Nebula Spiritual Guidance. The app was easy to navigate, and I quickly found an advisor whose profile matched what I was looking for. My reading felt thoughtful, compassionate, and surprisingly insightful. The advisor listened carefully, answered my questions with patience, and gave me guidance that helped me look at my situation from a new perspective.
reviews.reply: We're truly touched by your words ✨ It means so much to know Nebula felt thoughtful and supportive in such a meaningful moment. Warmly, Nebula Team 🔮

reviews.title: Helpful
reviews.text: I felt understood and the insights were very helpful and I got closure to some of my most difficult questions I could not share with others .
reviews.reply:
Hi [Name],
Thank you so much for sharing your kind words 🌸. We sincerely apologize if at any point you felt alone before finding this support — nobody should carry such difficult questions without care and understanding.
It truly warms our hearts to know that the insights you received brought you clarity and closure. Moments like this remind us why we do what we do — to help people feel heard, supported, and guided, especially when the weight feels too heavy to carry alone.
If ever new questions or challenges arise, please don’t hesitate to reach out directly at support-appstore@asknebula.com — we’ll always be here to listen and walk alongside you on your journey.

Nebula Support Team
